title: Choose the visual world for riah.dev (round 2)
question: The new roll assigned Gara Indigo. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Gara Indigo
options.lineage: Sierra Leonean gara tie-dye and resist-dyed indigo cloth
options.thesis: Infrastructure dyed into Sierra Leone's own cloth: RIAH's circuit mark becomes the resist pattern in deep indigo fields.
materials: drenched indigo dye fields with soft bleed
white resist patterns drawn from the logo's traces
big confident type set on the cloth
options.viewport: Full-bleed indigo cloth. Huge white headline saying what RIAH does, a ruled block naming all six services, one bright action. The logo's circuit mark repeats as a resist-dye pattern across the cloth.
options.risk: Could read as fashion or craft unless the copy and structure stay engineering-clear.

raised.raise: Billing block: the hero names all six services in one tight ruled block, so the offer reads in five seconds.
Face-out hierarchy: each section shows one item large and the rest compact, so nothing is equal weight.
Structure showing: one stitched trace runs down the page connecting every section, the only ornament.

options.label: Painted Agent Kiosk
options.lineage: Freetown's hand-painted mobile-money and telecom kiosks
options.thesis: The bold, painted signage everyone in Freetown reads daily, applied to an engineering firm.
options.viewport: A painted storefront: big blue sign 'RIAH SL', painted boards listing services like a kiosk menu.
options.risk: Very local and loud; ministries may find it informal. A familiar 'African vernacular' move.

options.label: Noir One-Sheet
options.thesis: Two inks, one huge shadow, a billing block.
options.viewport: A small figure, a giant shadow, condensed title.
options.case: Dramatic but suggests crime and menace, wrong for trust.
options.kept: The billing block naming every service at once.

options.label: Video Store Wall
options.thesis: Services as boxes on shelves by sector.
options.case: Playful nostalgia, no fit for public-sector buyers.

options.label: Coptic Exposed Binding
options.thesis: Nothing hidden; the structure is the ornament.
options.case: Honest structure, but bookish and quiet.
options.kept: One stitched trace connecting every section.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.viewport: A green trace on black glass.
options.case: The neon-on-black cliché, and hard for non-engineers.
options.kept: Every claim measured against a grid of specifics.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A classic corporate IT-services site, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Large photo of infrastructure with headline over it, two buttons, then a grid of service cards.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other IT firm; needs real photos you don't have yet.
